visualIdentity.silhouette: broad-shouldered frontline raider with asymmetrical fur mantle and heavy octarine cleaver silhouette
visualIdentity.face: weathered adult fighter, square jaw, broken nose, short dark beard and a pale diagonal scar over the left brow
visualIdentity.hair: close-cropped black hair with one shaved temple marked by a geometric octarine war glyph
signatureElements: asymmetrical fur mantle over the right shoulder
octarine war glyph on shaved temple
heavy chipped cleaver visible behind the shoulder
iron ring trophy attached to the chest harness
visualIdentity.outfit: layered leather and dark iron raider armor with reinforced chest harness and weathered fur mantle
visualIdentity.framing: bust portrait, three-quarter view, shoulders fully readable, transparent background
visualIdentity.lighting: hard warm key light with cool octarine rim light, preserving facial readability
consistencyRules: facial proportions and scar placement must remain identical across all states
fur mantle must stay on the right shoulder
war glyph shape and placement must not change
cleaver silhouette must remain recognizable behind the shoulder
armor, harness and trophy ring must remain unchanged

states.neutral: controlled confidence, relaxed jaw, focused forward gaze
states.speaking: assertive mid-sentence expression, visible mouth articulation without caricature
states.alert: sudden tension, raised brow and eyes tracking an immediate threat
states.combat: aggressive forward drive, clenched jaw and battle-ready intensity
states.victory: fierce restrained grin, proud posture and energized gaze
states.defeat: exhausted and wounded resolve, lowered gaze without loss of identity
